notes: Sahi sends up to 20 levels; the web publishes five, padded with empty rows, and acknowledges a Depth subscribe with actual_depth 5.

Order updates come from Sahi's order stream (web SahiOrderUpdateAdapter, openalgo#2474; desktop brokers/sahi/streaming/orders.rs): the REST token on the upgrade and no frame of its own, each frame a GET /v1/orders row mapped by the order book's own mapping (order_lifecycle), relayed again when Sahi repeats it after a reconnect (order_stream_reconnects).
